def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # fix label variants
    df['species'] = df['species'].replace({'Adeile': 'Adelie', 'Gentto': 'Gentoo'})
    df['island'] = df['island'].replace({'biscoe': 'Biscoe'})
    # body_mass_g is text with commas and out-of-range unit error
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=False)
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'], errors='coerce')
    # correct obvious factor-1000 error if it brings value into allowed range, otherwise NaN
    mask = df['body_mass_g'] > 6500
    # try dividing by 1000 for values like 3650000 -> 3650
    corrected = df.loc[mask, 'body_mass_g'] / 1000
    correctable = corrected.between(2500, 6500)
    df.loc[mask & df.index.isin(correctable[correctable].index), 'body_mass_g'] = corrected[correctable]
    # any remaining out of range -> NaN
    df.loc[(df['body_mass_g'] < 2500) | (df['body_mass_g'] > 6500), 'body_mass_g'] = pd.NA
    # ensure flipper_length_mm numeric (sample shows as text)
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    return df

def answer(df):
    # average body mass for each sex, drop missing sex keys
    df = df.dropna(subset=['sex'])
    # body_mass_g already numeric and out-of-range cleaned
    g = df.groupby('sex', dropna=True)['body_mass_g'].mean()
    return {str(k): float(v) for k, v in g.items() if pd.notna(k) and pd.notna(v)}
